title: You don’t have to walk alone.
description: Sign in to prepare your community profile. Sharing will always be your choice; your private journal stays on this device.
unavailable: Together sign-in is not available yet. You can still walk the path and keep your stones.
offline: You can keep your journal here while offline. Reconnect to sign in or change your community profile.

profile.welcome: Welcome. What should your people call you? Choose a name and a handle for Together.
profile.existing: This is how your name will appear in Together. Friends, groups and sharing are coming next.
profile.name: What should your people call you?
profile.nameHint: A first name or nickname is enough. This name is for your community profile.
profile.handleHint: Use 3–30 letters, numbers or underscores. Begin with a letter or number. Your handle helps people find you when friends are available.
profile.saved: Your community profile is saved. Your private stones are still on this device.

callback.title: Welcome back to Ebenezer.
callback.description: We’re bringing you back to your space.

errors.session: We couldn’t open your account. Try again; your journal is still here.
errors.signIn: We couldn’t open Google sign-in. Please try again in a moment.
errors.signOut: We couldn’t finish signing out. Reconnect and try again.
errors.load: We couldn’t open your community profile. Check your connection and try again.
errors.save: We couldn’t save your community profile. Check your connection and try again.
errors.invalidProfile: Please enter a name of up to 120 characters and a handle using 3–30 letters, numbers or underscores.
errors.handleTaken: That handle is already in use. Try another one—you can keep the same name.
errors.sessionExpired: Your account session has ended. Sign out, then continue with Google again. Your journal is still here.
errors.callback: We couldn’t finish this sign-in. Return to account settings and continue with Google again.
errors.cancelled: You didn’t finish signing in. You can try again whenever you’re ready.
